model.description: BUILT v0.7.112: FeatureManager.allowedUsersChildren @ src/ts/server/FeatureManager.ts — R31.8c gap-A. A Feature's allowedUsers TOKENS → itemView child-nodes with a COMPOSITE uuid '<featureUuid>:<userId=sha256(token)[:16]>' (ref = 'profile:<featureUuid>:<userId=sha256(token)[:16]>' → rb-profile-detail parses the feature context for REVOKE); type:'profile', name = live-profile name or masked token. Called by /api/trace/children on a Feature unit (the raw tokens aren't ior:instance refs so the default forward-ref resolver can't build them). Marker [impl:uuid:ad622052-...] on the allowedUsersChildren decl. R31.8c. FIX-2 LIVE (v0.7.114, 2fea8b5f6, impl-edit riding THIS marker): the composite ref is <featureUuid>:<userId> where userId=sha256(token).slice(0,16) (OPAQUE — the raw auth token appears NOWHERE in the ref/body); server resolves userId->token for display+revoke by hashing the Feature allowedUsers set. Tests: 55d125ee (opaque-ref/no-token-in-ref) + f38f87af (N-in->N-children completeness).
